correctness.rationale: Unique maximal-run decomposition and a two-state transfer yield the stated rational G. Its formal derivatives give the exact mean and second moment; the difference yields the cubic variance with small-n exceptions. An explicit one-dependent Bernoulli sum has limiting normal law; higher-order terms are o_P(n^{3/2}). Two independent exact recurrences agree through n=26 and direct deletion sets through n=12. Proof covers all stated integers; tests are not used as an infinite certificate.

value.rationale: For fixed ordered scattered deletions, distinct residual output count measures ambiguity under a specified error event. Its prior mean does not quantify dispersion; the new complete law, sharp cubic variance and n^{3/2}-scaled normal limit identify natural error-output fluctuations. These are all-length structural probabilistic results rather than an arbitrary numerical table.
